name: How long does a typical kitchen drywall repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen drywall repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen drywall repair depends on the extent of the damage. Small patches for dents or nail holes might take a few hours, including drying time. Larger repairs involving cutting out damaged sections, installing new drywall, taping, mudding, and sanding typically require 1-3 days, allowing for proper drying between coats of joint compound. Painting will add additional time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; small patches take hours, while larger repairs involving replacement and finishing can take 1-3 days.
